g.text: One immutable image per service, published to GHCR and promoted by tag — uat tracks main; a version tag ships prod.
on push:main and on vX.Y.Z tags
CD resolves newest image per service:
Today the deploy scripts build each image on the VM (tar-ship source → docker build). Target CD: build once in CI, then pull the
same GHCR image by env tag — uat floats on latest/sha-*, prod pins the release version. The pattern extends to more envs (e.g. staging) via overlays/<env>.tfvars.
